text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (May 22, 2025) for 24 Anglesey Boulevard

The Property Standards Committee – Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (May 22, 2025) for 24 Anglesey Boulevard, Folder Number 25 161941 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to March 2, 2026 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
